limitations: This roadmap does not create legal authority or expand any target scope.
This roadmap does not qualify, deploy, route to or execute any specialist.
Taxonomy references are planning inputs and must be version-pinned when vector records are generated.
Defined profiles are design records, not evidence that a capable implementation exists.
Real-environment operations require separate mission, target, identity, action-tier, monitoring and cleanup authority.
Production deployment decisions remain separate from the Army v2 catalog migration.
migration_rules: Do not modify or delete the trusted v1 registry during v2 construction.
Preserve every existing profile ID and make additions only through unused command and specialist numbers.
Treat broad v1 specialists as integration owners until explicit retirement evidence exists.
Create every new profile in defined status with pilot false and no implied qualification.
Keep production routing bound to qualified profiles and separately authorized routing policy versions.
Require independent control and assurance for qualification, canary and retirement decisions.
Require restoration evidence for any controlled action that changes an approved target.

phases.completion_gate: The v2 registry contains 391 specialists, 25 commanders and 35 shared profiles, with all new profiles defined and inactive.

phases.completion_gate: Every vector has ownership, evidence, safeguards, cleanup, qualification and blind-spot fields.

phases.completion_gate: Every specialist has meaningful capability edges and every vector has primary and supporting coverage.
phases.objective: Replace name-restatement capabilities with primary, supporting and validation relationships for every specialist.
phases.title: Capability graph v2

phases.completion_gate: Every v2 specialist has a non-generic qualification plan with independent validation requirements.
phases.objective: Generate vector-specific scenarios, expected evidence, critical failures and action-tier boundaries.

phases.completion_gate: Every v2 specialist has an implementation-ready, fail-closed blueprint.
phases.objective: Define implementable inputs, tools, adapters, outputs, controls and evidence contracts for all v2 specialists.
phases.title: Candidate blueprints v2

phases.completion_gate: All candidate builds are ordered by risk, dependency, coverage gain and verification capacity.
phases.objective: Generate dependency-ordered implementation packages and commander review queues.

phases.completion_gate: Each candidate passes static, unit, integration, containment and evidence-contract checks.
phases.objective: Implement bounded candidates in prioritized waves without granting qualification or routing authority.
phases.title: Candidate implementation waves

phases.completion_gate: Only candidates with complete evidence and no unresolved critical failures become qualified.
phases.objective: Run signed, reproducible scenario packs with independent control and assurance review.
phases.title: Independent qualification waves

phases.completion_gate: Routing changes remain non-production until coverage, correctness and safety thresholds are met.
phases.objective: Exercise qualified specialists on mirrored missions and score their handoffs, conflicts and coverage.
phases.title: Shadow routing and collaboration

phases.completion_gate: Each canary has explicit target authority, action tier, monitoring, stop conditions, evidence custody and restoration proof.
phases.objective: Authorize bounded live canaries for selected qualified profiles in approved real environments.

phases.completion_gate: No v1 route is retired without a qualified replacement, successful canary evidence and a tested rollback path.
phases.objective: Retire superseded v1 ownership only after v2 equivalence and operational evidence are independently verified.
